programme.title: 100% loup
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin, héritier d'une fière famille de loups-garous, est certain qu'il deviendra le plus redoutable de tous les loups-garous. Or, le jour de son 13e anniversaire, quelle n'est pas sa surprise lorsque sa première translouptation tourne mal et qu'il se transforme en un féroce petit caniche. Juste au moment où Freddy pense que sa vie ne peut pas être pire, il est rejeté par sa meute et se fait attraper par la fourrière. Freddy et sa nouvelle amie Batty vont tenter de s'échapper.

programme.title: Hommes en noir III
programme.desc: Les agents J et K sont de retour dans le temps. J a vu des choses inexplicables au cours de ses 15 ans avec les Hommes en noir, mais rien, pas même les extraterrestres, ne le laisse aussi perplexe que son partenaire désabusé et réticent. Cependant, lorsque la vie de K et le sort de la planète sont mis en jeu, l'agent J doit voyager dans le temps pour remettre les choses en ordre. Il découvre qu'il y a des secrets dans l'univers dont K ne lui avait jamais parlé.

programme.title: TVA Nouvelles

programme.desc: Un soir d'ivresse, Pierre, écrivain explorateur, fait une chute de plusieurs étages. Cet accident le plonge dans un coma profond. Sur son lit d'hôpital, revenu à la vie, il se fait la promesse de traverser la France à pied du Mercantour au Cotentin. Un voyage unique et hors du temps à la rencontre de l'hyper-ruralité, de la beauté de la France et de la renaissance de soi.

Fantasque, aimant passionnément la vie, curieux de tout, mais diminué, il demande à sa fille de l'aider à mourir. Avec l'aide de sa soeur Pascale, elle va devoir choisir: accepter la volonté de son père ou le convaincre de changer d'avis.

programme.title: Comme dans l'espace

programme.title: Radio enfer

programme.title: Radio enfer

programme.title: Quelles familles!

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Nunavummi Mamarijavut
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, South Baffin) In this episode of Nunavummi Mamarijavut, we travel to Rankin Inlet where Rosemary Sandy and Judy Eecherk prepare and enjoy a meal of trout as they talk about their fishing memories of the past.

programme.title: (Innu-aimun) Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Constance Lake First Nation, Ontario - Sturgeon
programme.desc: (Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit) In the Northern Ontario community of Constance Lake, Chuck goes sturgeon fishing with Austin Baxter and local youth. Baxter, a suicide prevention worker for teens, teaches them all about fishing.

programme.title: (Innu-aimun) De Pessamit à Sheshatshiu
programme.desc: (Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit) Poursuivant son enquête sur le système scolaire, Moïra rencontre les aînés qui ont connu les écoles de village, les pensionnats, l'université et même ceux qui ont tout refusé. Outre l'éloignement de la langue.

programme.title: (Cree) Red Earth Uncovered
programme.desc: (Cree, Plains) After speaking with eyewitnesses, Shayla decides to explore the woods and look for evidence of Sasquatch.

programme.title: (Cree) Wild Rose Vets
programme.desc: (Cree, Plains) Dr. Emma takes on her first rabbit surgery and tackles her fear of rodents. Dr. Allison and the team realize Callie the dog has more than a sore tooth when a routine dental reveals bigger problems below the surface.

programme.title: (Michif) Amplify
programme.desc: (Michif, French) Inuk singer Beatrice Deer delves into the history of residential schools to write a song in tribute to the lost children in unmarked graves. Filmed almost entirely in Inuktitut, this episode features an interview with Nakuset.

programme.title: (Michif) Nation Untamed
programme.desc: (Michif, Heritage) Sam and Chuck travel to southwestern Colorado to learn about the Southern Ute Tribe. Trekking through the magnificent San Juan Mountains in search of a mountain lion, they come face to face with an apex predator.

programme.title: (Salish) Warrior Games
programme.desc: (Salish) Host Steve Sxwithul'txw gives snowboarding a try, quickly learning that the bigger and taller you are, the harder you fall. Meanwhile, the Indigenous youth he visits are at home in the winter landscape, moving effortlessly through the snow.

programme.title: (Nsyilxcen) Quest Out West Wild Food
programme.desc: (Nsyilxcen) Tracey meets with three community leaders to discuss how they are guiding the next generation and fostering a healthy community. Tracey shares her knowledge and helps create a delicious meal of sausage with salad.

programme.title: (Halkomelem) Nations at War
programme.desc: (Halkomelem) The five nations of the Iroquois were once bitter enemies, until the peacemaker's law bound them together. The Iroquois used their newfound strength, commerce, diplomacy and firepower to destroy their enemies and fight the French Empire.

programme.title: (Mi'kmaq) Spirit Talker
programme.desc: (Mi'kmaq) Shawn's journey brings him to Saint Mary's First Nation, a Maliseet Community in New Brunswick. Seven years after her death, the spirit of a young girl comes through for her mother. Shawn also makes a powerful spirit connection for a widow.

programme.title: (Mi'kmaq) Gespe'gewa'gi: The Last Land
programme.desc: (Mi'kmaq) Mi'gmaq fishing guides prepare for the 2019 salmon season at the Kedgwick Lodge. The Kedgwick River used to be full of salmon, so we learn what the Listuguj science team is doing to increase the salmon population in the river.

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Tiiturta
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, South Baffin) This episode focuses on the state of the Inuktitut language among Inuit, examining how residential schools contributed to its decline and highlighting current efforts to preserve, promote and revitalize it.

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Ajungi!
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, South Baffin) Solomon Awa teaches his daughter Hanna Awa how to make a qauliut, a tool for stretching sealskin boots called kamiks. Later, Inuk Elder Abigail Idlout demonstrates how to use the qauliut to stretch kamiks for Jessica Joamie.

programme.title: (Atikamekw) Première ligne
programme.desc: (Atikamekw) During a party at Mashteuiatsh on the shore of Lake Saint-Jean, volunteer lifeguard Raymond Launière and his spouse Marcelle intervened to save a man from heart failure after a canoe race.

programme.title: (Blackfoot) Horse Warriors
programme.desc: (Blackfoot, Siksika) It's the final weekend of the Calgary Stampede and both Two Medicine and Poitras Relay have their eyes on a spot in the championship. This is the first time the Calgary Stampede is crowning an Indian Relay champion.

programme.title: (Blackfoot) Coastal Carvings
programme.desc: (Blackfoot) Jeremy and Jerett choose a tree for their artistic trade and take on a new door commission. Jordan, the silversmith, attempts to bring the ranch logo designed by Jeremy to life.

programme.title: (Cree) Rabbit Soup
programme.desc: (Cree, Swampy) It's time to head north! First, Melva and Davey experience summer in the Arctic. Then, it's time to gear up with some seriously warm clothes. Davey tries his hand at dogsledding and building an igloo, and then he and Melva try.

programme.title: (Cree) Little Big Community
programme.desc: (Cree, James Bay) Iqaluit, the capital of Nunavut, translates to place of many fish in Inuktitut, reflecting the region's abundant wildlife. Meet Aasivak and Laura, two influential leaders in their community on a mission to preserve Inuit traditions.

programme.title: (Stl'atl'imx) Tribal Police Files
programme.desc: (Stl'atl'imx) An action-packed episode starts with St'at'imc Fountain Valley Xaxli'p First Nation declaring a state of emergency due to a dangerous rock slide. A constable responds to confusing reports of a man in crisis.

programme.desc: (Tutchone, Northern) In this episode of Yukon Harvest, Brett travels to the Bloodvein community, where he meets his biological family for the first time before heading on an expedition that goes awry.

programme.title: (Mi'kmaq) Merchants of the Wild
programme.desc: (Mi'kmaq) Back amongst the others, Britt wants to provide for her friends and invites Ethan to help her create their own hunting camp deeper in the bush. Using their new hunting tools and all their new skills, they hunt small game and make a shelter.

programme.title: (Wolastoqey) Petroglyphs to Pixels
programme.desc: (Wolastoqey) The story of repatriation and provenance of Haida art is one of cultural resilience. Efforts to reclaim these priceless pieces began over fifty years ago and continue today.

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Adventures on Inuit Land
programme.sub-title: Nanuk of the North 100 Years Part 2
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, Nunavik) In this episode, we continue to celebrate one of the most significant northern documentaries turning 100 years old by joining in a community feast, music festival, craft fair and more!

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Tiiturta
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, South Baffin) This episode focuses on the state of the Inuktitut language among Inuit, examining how residential schools contributed to its decline and highlighting current efforts to preserve, promote and revitalize it.

programme.title: (Inuktitut) Nunavummi Mamarijavut
programme.desc: (Inuktitut, South Baffin) In this episode of Nunavummi Mamarijavut, host Zipporah Ungalaq collects fresh clams and meets up with Malaya Ipeelie to make a delicious batch of muktuk and clam chowder with local ingredients from Nunavut.

programme.title: (Dene) Arm Nation
programme.desc: (Dene, Denesuline)It's thefinal day of The Canadian National Championships and tensions are high.Donna Purdy, Steph Heroux, Natasha Batt,Evan Bourgoin and Adam Bourgoin,all endure their final reckoning as they face off against the best arm wrestlers.

programme.title: (Anishinaabemowin) Tribal Police Files
programme.desc: (Anishinaabemowin)Matt recalls the day he tried to save a young girl from drowning.Doug and Jules patrol Lake Couchiching and caution some carless jet-skiers.Tom recounts the history of the drum in Indigenous culture and Jules invests in real estate.

programme.title: (Dakota) Grandma Sherry's Kitchen
programme.desc: (Dakota) In today's episode, Grandma Sherry shares how to make a traditional feast of hominy soup, her family's incredible fry bread and a perfectly sweet saskatoon berry pudding. Grandma Sherry's cousin joins to provide help and company.

programme.title: (Dakota) Wild Archaeology
programme.desc: (Dakota) The team digs deeper into the past at Snake Bay. They examine shíshálh pictographs, learn about the ancestors buried at kwenten mac'wali and the advanced forensics used to reconstruct their facial features.

programme.title: (Tutchone) Yukon Harvest
programme.desc: (Tutchone, Northern) In this retrospective episode, the hunters and guides reflect on their journeys from the past season. From the Yukon wilds to the Northwest Territories and beyond, we check in with the hunters in the present day as they share.

programme.title: (Tutchone) Yukon Harvest
programme.desc: (Tutchone, Northern) Gwich'in hunting guide and new empty-nester, Derek, invites his teenage nephew, Jet, to leave Vancouver Island for a fishing trip in the Northwest Territories. Out on the water, Derek teaches Jet the value of processing fish.

programme.title: (Tutchone) Yukon Harvest
programme.desc: (Tutchone, Northern) In this episode of Yukon Harvest, we catch up with our hunters and guides at home as they reflect on their adventures from this season.

programme.title: (Mi'kmaq) Gespe'gewa'gi: The Last Land
programme.desc: (Mi'kmaq) Celebrating three seasons of growth, this episode highlights the journey of Mi'gmaq fishers, evolving from fledgling fishers to a formidable commercial presence on Canada's East Coast.

programme.title: (Mi'kmaq) Mi'kma'ki
programme.desc: (Mi'kmaq) Chief Mi'sel Joe launches a groundbreaking genetic research project to uncover the truth and understand how the Beothuk were assimilated into Mi'kmaw communities for protection in the 1800s.

programme.title: (Innu-aimun) Sur Le Terrain
programme.desc: (Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit) In Manawan, a concerned nurse prepares medication for a young woman who is at risk of experiencing a spontaneous abortion. Later, first responders head out in search of a young woman who is having suicidal thoughts.

programme.title: (Innu-aimun) Policier autochtone
programme.desc: (Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit) Les policiers expliquent l'application du Code de la sécurité routière dans leur communauté. Ils érigent des barrages contre l'alcool au volant et font de la prévention auprès de jeunes motoneigistes.

programme.title: La porte des étoiles

programme.title: La porte des étoiles
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Les faux amisLe SG-1 découvre une excellente opportunité de former une alliance avec les Aschen, une race très évoluée. L'objectif : partager avec eux des techniques médicales.

programme.title: La porte des étoiles
programme.desc: S05 E11 — Ultime recoursUn véhicule russe est victime d'une embuscade et son contenu dérobé. Carter est kidnappée, Hammond autorise O'Neill et Daniel à mener une investigation. Ceux-ci remontent la piste jusqu'à un hôpital où se déroulent de dangereuses expérimentations.

programme.title: La porte des étoiles
